messages:
ashley: Heads up — deploybot started the events.add_index migration in the 02:00 maintenance window and hit a stall on backfill. locking observed on primary.

mike: saw it, logs show repeated tx wait for 120s, replicas lagging ~30s.

deploybot: automated alert: migration job events.add_index paused due to lock threshold (lock_wait > 90s). Canary traffic routed to stable v2.

carla: can we get the exact migration id? need to correlate with the release notes.

ashley: migration id 2026-03-21-evt-idx, rolled with app tag v3.2.7. The migration runs a large index build with concurrent backfill.

minh: quick health signals: p95 write latency on primary jumped to 420ms after job start, error rate up 0.6% (mostly deadlocks).

mike: rollback criteria check — remind me what we agreed for long-running schema ops?

carla: agreed thresholds: >0.5% error or sustained p95 >300ms for 5m -> abort. This matches.

ashley: propose aborting the running migration and pinning deploys to v3.2.6 until we rework backfill. Thoughts?

minh: +1 to pin. Also recommend enabling read-only fallback for read-heavy routes (feature flag) so UX impact is minimal.

mike: plan: 1) abort migration job via deploybot stop-job 2026-03-21-evt-idx 2) unpin canary and pin prod routing to v3.2.6 3) open postmortem checklist and add to release notes under incidents

ashley: I'll run the abort. @deploybot can you confirm safe-stop procedure?

carla: note: abort will leave partial index artifacts. We need a cleanup job to drop the partial index before retry. Add that to the task.

deploybot: acknowledged. Running: deploybot stop-job --id=2026-03-21-evt-idx --graceful. Estimated stop time 30s.

sre-bot: system: replica lag at stop request = 28s. monitoring alerts suppressed for maintenance.

mike: once stop completes, we should update release notes with an entry: "Migration aborted: events.add_index flagged due to locking; rolled back to v3.2.6. Follow-up: schedule smaller segmented backfill and add KV-caching to reduce contention."

ashley: stop completed. deploybot: confirm job state.

deploybot: job status: stopped (graceful). Partial index present: events_idx_partial_20260321.

carla: opening cleanup runbook now — will drop partial index during low traffic window and run DDL validate.

minh: I'll pin traffic: routing pin set to v3.2.6 for prod and canary. Rolling back any live deployments to that tag.

mike: update release notes PR with the incident blurb and the rollback decision. Also add rollback playbook steps and owners.

ashley: owners: ashley -> abort + notes, carla -> cleanup + PR for segmented backfill, minh -> pin + monitoring, mike -> release notes + postmortem.

carla: quick reminder: also add DB migration flag toggle in future PRs so we can gate backfills without full deploy rollback.

minh: adding alert thresholds to the runbook: lock_wait > 60s for 3 consecutive checks triggers auto-pause.

mike: good. After cleanup we'll schedule a dry-run against a replica using LIMIT-based chunking and KV-prefix caching. No full backfill until we validate.

ashley: thanks all. I'll follow up in release notes and create the postmortem stub.

carla: FYI tagging compliance for audit: record migration abort reason and snapshot of migration job logs to the release ticket.

deploybot: archived job logs at https://internal.logs/2026-03-21-evt-idx (access: infra-team).

sre-bot: monitoring: alerts cleared, primary latency back to baseline.

mike: closing thread — we'll reconvene in the postmortem. :thumbsup:
